server.title: Connect your server
server.description: Janji works with your own Cal.diy server. Enter the address you open in your browser to use Cal.diy.
server.apiAddressHint: Only needed if your server runs Cal API v2 at a different address, for example https://api.example.com/v2.

errors.invalid: That doesn't look like a web address. Try something like book.example.com.
errors.insecure: Janji only connects over a secure connection. Use an address that starts with https://.
errors.api_address_invalid: That doesn't look like a web address. Try something like https://api.example.com/v2.
errors.not_cal_api: The server answered, but Cal API v2 isn't available there. Cal API v2 runs as a separate service next to Cal.diy, so it may not be set up on this server yet.
errors.unreachable: Couldn't reach that server. Check the address and your internet connection.
errors.timeout: The server took too long to answer. Try again in a moment.
